# UI/UX Skill guidance for Copilot

- Use [the AI agent usage guide](../docs/agent-usage-guide.md) and [Skill index](../skills/index.md) to choose relevant Skills.
- Select one primary Skill and add only the supporting Skills required by the task; avoid loading all 15 by default.
- Read the selected `SKILL.md` and the references relevant to the current decision.
- Inspect the actual artifact when available. Label observations, user reports, inferences, proposals, and verified checks separately.
- Cite exact source IDs from `docs/source-registry.csv` for library-backed claims and state access limitations.
- Keep to the user's requested scope and report what was actually checked, including unverified areas.
